snippet.title: Club Soko - Launch Date Announcement!
snippet.description:
Navigate your way through an underground nightclub and discover its secrets. Play as Maude, a graffiti artist compelled to tag up the walls of a nightclub at every possible opportunity. As you move your way past bouncers and drunk club goers you come to discover there’s more to Club Soko than meets the eye.

Wishlist it on Steam 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346410/Club_Soko/

Music by Gareth Gorvin

#gaming #puzzle #clubsoko #indiegame #metal
